rules.title: Page and Layout params prop is now asynchronous in Next.js 16
rules.description: In Next.js 16, params passed to Pages, Layouts, generateMetadata, and Route Handlers is a Promise. Synchronously accessing properties on params without await or React.use() is deprecated and causes runtime failures.

remediation.summary: Await params before accessing properties, e.g. const { slug } = await params;

rules.title: searchParams prop is now asynchronous in Next.js 16
rules.description: In Next.js 16, searchParams passed to Server Component pages is a Promise. Accessing properties synchronously without await is deprecated.

remediation.summary: Await searchParams before accessing query parameters.

rules.title: middleware convention replaced by proxy in Next.js 16
rules.description: The middleware.ts / middleware.js convention has been deprecated in favor of proxy.ts / proxy.js network boundary handlers running on the Node.js runtime.

remediation.summary: Rename middleware.ts to proxy.ts and update handler export.

rules.title: next/amp module has been completely removed in Next.js 16
rules.description: AMP support has been removed in Next.js 16. Imports from 'next/amp' and useAmp() will throw build errors.

remediation.summary: Remove next/amp import and migrate to responsive HTML components.
remediation.exampleBefore:
import { useAmp } from 'next/amp';
export const config = { amp: 'hybrid' };
remediation.exampleAfter: // Remove next/amp import and use modern responsive design

rules.title: unstable_cache is deprecated in favor of 'use cache' directive in Next.js 16
rules.description: unstable_cache from 'next/cache' is deprecated in favor of the new 'use cache' directive and cacheLife() / cacheTag() APIs.

remediation.summary: Replace unstable_cache with 'use cache' directive or fetch cache tags.
remediation.exampleBefore:
import { unstable_cache } from 'next/cache';
const getCached = unstable_cache(async () => db.query(), ['tag']);

rules.title: revalidateTag profile changed; use updateTag / cacheTag
rules.description: revalidateTag profile changed in Next.js 16. Use updateTag for read-your-writes or cacheTag for tag management.

remediation.summary: Review revalidateTag calls and migrate to updateTag for read-your-writes consistency.

rules.title: serverRuntimeConfig and publicRuntimeConfig removed from next.config.js in Next.js 16
rules.description: serverRuntimeConfig and publicRuntimeConfig in next.config.js have been completely removed. Use process.env directly or NEXT_PUBLIC_ env variables.

remediation.summary: Remove serverRuntimeConfig and publicRuntimeConfig; read process.env directly.
remediation.exampleAfter:
const nextConfig = {};
// Use process.env.MY_KEY in server code

rules.title: Custom webpack config detected with default Turbopack compiler in Next.js 16
rules.description: In Next.js 16, Turbopack is the default bundler for both dev and production. Custom webpack functions in next.config.js will be ignored unless Turbopack equivalents or --webpack flag is provided.

remediation.summary: Migrate custom webpack rules to Turbopack loader configuration in next.config.js.

rules.title: export const runtime = 'edge' on middleware is deprecated in Next.js 16
rules.description: Running middleware on Edge runtime is deprecated in Next.js 16. Proxy handlers run by default on Node.js runtime for broad npm package compatibility.

remediation.summary: Remove runtime = 'edge' from proxy / middleware and use standard Node.js runtime.
remediation.exampleAfter: // Removed: proxy runs on Node.js runtime with full native support

rules.title: getInitialProps in Pages router is deprecated in Next.js 16
rules.description: getInitialProps in Pages router is deprecated in Next.js 16. Use getStaticProps / getServerSideProps or migrate page to the App Router.

remediation.summary: Migrate getInitialProps to getServerSideProps or convert to App Router Server Components.
